Astronomers have found peculiar clues lurking far beyond Neptune. What if a massive, undiscovered world is quietly shepherding the clustered, tilted orbits of extreme trans-Neptunian objects over 250 AU away? If the hypothetical Planet Nine truly exists in the outer solar system, its gravity could explain these mysterious alignments—unless the clustering is merely an observational bias. Would you explore the solar system's frozen edge? Follow for more what-ifs.

Based on today's news: Big News: A Massive Ninth Planet Candidate May Be Hiding Far Beyond Neptune
